name: CO2 compression and dehydration
principle: Captured CO2 is compressed in integrally geared or in-line compressors to dense phase (around 135 barg in the Drax BECCS case) and dried to about 50 ppmv water (TEG, silica gel or molecular sieve, below 1 ppmv with sieve) before pipeline transport. The Drax cases at about 4 Mtpa needed 32.6 to 40.8 MW of compressor power depending on suction pressure.

process_steps.name: Suction from capture plant at 0.6 to 3 barg
Dehydration
equipment: TEG, silica gel or molecular sieve unit
